# SARIF 2.1.0 schema fixture

The adjacent JSON file is the complete official OASIS SARIF 2.1.0 COS02 schema,
retrieved unchanged on 2026-10-21 from
[the OASIS schema](https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/cos02/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json).
It is retained locally so whole-document interoperability regressions do not
depend on network access during tests. No field subset or relaxed local schema
stands in for the published contract.
